json.name: Teide 3 Hours - Individual
json.desc:
Get ready for a unique adventure behind the wheel of your own buggy! Drive along stunning trails at the base of Mount Teide, the highest peak in Spain, while enjoying volcanic landscapes and unforgettable panoramic views. This route takes you through dirt roads, natural viewpoints, and areas of great ecological value. Ideal for lovers of adrenaline and nature.
Duration: 2–3 hours
Includes: professional guide, helmet, insurance

json.name: Teide 3 Hours – Double
json.desc:
Share the adventure with a companion at your side while you explore the volcanic landscapes of Teide in a double buggy. Perfect for couples, friends, or family, this tour combines thrill, nature, and fun. Drive on dirt paths, cross unique zones, and admire the grandeur of the National Park.
Duration: 2–3 hours
Includes: professional guide, helmets, insurance

json.name: Sunset 3 Hours - Individual
json.desc:
Drive your own buggy and enjoy a unique experience at the end of the day. As the sun sets, the colors of the sky and natural surroundings create a magical atmosphere perfect for adventure lovers. A perfect blend of excitement, unforgettable landscapes, and freedom on wheels.
Duration: 2–3 hours
Includes: professional guide, helmet, insurance

json.name: Diamond Tour Resident
json.desc:
A package to enjoy the maximum exclusivity of Loro Parque's services. Buy your Diamond Tour and, in addition to access to Loro Parque, you can enjoy Loro Explore, a one and a half hour guided tour of the most exclusive areas of the park, reserved seats at the shows and a fantastic lunch in our restaurant Brunelli's Steakhouse (located in front of the park), where you can enjoy the best meats in the world and the stunning sea views offered by its large window. After lunch you can continue to enjoy the park. 

Menu:
- Brunelli's Salad
- 300 grams Uruguayan Rib Eye with french fries and vegetables 
- American Cheesecake
- Drink and bread

Children's Menu. Choose between: 
- Spaghetti napolitana, chicken nuggets with fries or escalope with fries.
- Ice cream and drink.

 Note: Children under 3 to 5 years old will pay what they consume directly in the restaurant.
